title: sign(): add multi-signer test with OpenSSL oracle
description: Add a test that calls sign() with two keys (RSA + P-256 ECDSA). Verify: (1) the output is accepted by openssl smime -verify; (2) verify() returns two SignerResults both verified=true; (3) SignedData.version is V1 (both use IAS). Also test the SKI path: if a key uses SubjectKeyIdentifier, SignedData.version must be V3. The two-signer fixture must be generated via OpenSSL independently to serve as an oracle for verify(), not just sign()->verify() round-trip.
